appInstallDescription: Open your mailbox in its own app window, with quick access to chats and email.
appInstallIosAdd: Choose “Add to Home Screen”, then tap “Add”.
appInstallIosFallback: If “Add to Home Screen” is missing, open this site in Safari.
appInstallAndroid: Open the browser menu, choose “Install app” or “Add to Home Screen”, and confirm.
appInstallMac: In a supported Safari version, choose File → Add to Dock, then confirm.
appInstallDesktop: In Chrome or Edge, click the install icon in the address bar, or choose “Install this page as an app” from the browser menu.
appInstallAvailability: Installation depends on browser support. If no install option is available, try a current Chrome or Edge version.
